* Sample information

Samples for miRNA analysis
```{r}
lowQual <- c("PabK14-03SM_SR1","PabK14-03RO_SR2","Pab738_2_FMG_MIR1")

samples <- bind_rows(
  read_tsv(here("doc/metadata_SE.tsv"), show_col_types=F) %>%
    dplyr::filter(! grepl("-unk",stage)) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(sample = NGI_ID,
                  sampleName = User_ID) %>%
    mutate(temp = gsub("PabK14-03","",sampleName),
           Stage = gsub("-unk","",stage)) %>%
    separate_wider_delim(temp, delim = "_", names = c("SampleType","rep")) %>%
    mutate(Dataset = "SE",
           Type = "SE",
           StageType = gsub("S","SE_",Stage),
           Replicate = substr(rep,3,3),
           SampleName = paste0(Stage,"-",SampleType,"-",Replicate)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-stage, -Mreads, -`>=Q30`, -Status, -rep, -replicate) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Stage %in% paste0("S",1:6)),
  read_csv(here("doc/metadataZE_mRNA_miRNA.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(! is.na(miR_NGI_ID)) %>% 
    mutate(StageType = paste0(Type, "_", Stage),
           Stage = paste0("Z",Stage)) %>% 
    mutate(StageType = factor(StageType, levels = c(paste0("SD_",1:3),
                                                    "ZE_4","FG_4",
                                                    "ZE_5","FG_5",
                                                    "ZE_6","FG_6",
                                                    "ZE_7","FG_7",
                                                    "ZE_8-9","FG_8-9",
                                                    "ZE_10","FG_10")),
           Stage = factor(as.character(Stage), levels = paste0("Z",as.character(c(1:7,"8-9",10)))),
           Dataset = "ZE") %>% 
    dplyr::select(-SampleID, -lincRNA_ID) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(sample = miR_NGI_ID,
                  sampleName = miR_User_ID,
                  description = SampleDescription)) %>% 
  mutate(StageType = factor(StageType,
                        levels = c(
                          paste0("SE_",1:6),
                          paste0("SD_",1:3),
                          paste0("ZE_",c(4:7,"8-9",10)),
                          paste0("FG_",c(4:7,"8-9",10)))),
         Stage = factor(Stage, levels = c(paste0("S",1:6),paste0("Z",c(1:7,"8-9",10))))) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(! sampleName %in% lowQual)
```

# Target prediction (all miRs)

Following programs will be used to predict targets against longest transcript of each gene in PA v2.0

* *psRNATarget* https://www.zhaolab.org/psRNATarget/analysis?function=3 , here we keep target pairs with expectation score <= 5 (default)

* *psRobot* v1.2 http://omicslab.genetics.ac.cn/psRobot/downloads.php

* *tapir* https://github.com/erbon7/tapir

* *TargetFinder* https://github.com/carringtonlab/TargetFinder

All tools except psRNATarget were run locally using default parameters. psRNATarget was on the webserver and also run with default parameters.

## psRNATarget
```{r}
targetsPT <- read_tsv(list.files(here("data/analysis/results/targetPrediction_all"),
                                 pattern = "psRNATarget", full.names = TRUE),
                      show_col_types = FALSE, comment = "#") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(miRNA_Acc. %in% repChecked)

ggplot(targetsPT, aes(x=Expectation)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3,3.5,4,4.5,5)) +
  ggtitle("psRNATarget Expectation score of miRNA-mRNA pairs") +
  theme_bw()
```

## TargetFinder
```{r}
targetsTF <- list.files(here("data/analysis/results/targetPrediction_all/TargetFinder"),full.names = TRUE) %>%
  map(~ grep("^query=", readLines(.x), value = TRUE)) %>%
  discard_at(map_dbl(.,length) == 0) %>%
  map(function(l){
    strsplit(l, ",\\s*") %>%
      map(function(v){
        kv_pairs <- sapply(v, function(x) strsplit(x, "=")[[1]])
        keys <- sapply(kv_pairs, `[`, 1)
        values <- sapply(kv_pairs, `[`, 2)
        names(values) <- keys
        return(values)
      }) %>%
      bind_rows()
  }) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(score = as.numeric(score)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(query %in% repChecked)

ggplot(targetsTF, aes(x=score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3,3.5,4)) +
  ggtitle("TargetFinder score of miRNA-mRNA pairs") +
  theme_bw()
```

## psRobot
```{r}
targetsPR <- list.files(here("data/analysis/results/targetPrediction_all/PSROBOT"),full.names = TRUE) %>%
  map(~ grep("^>", readLines(.x), value = TRUE)) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>% 
  map(strsplit, split= "\t") %>%
  unlist(recursive = FALSE, use.names = FALSE) %>% 
  map(setNames,c("miRNA","score","target")) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(miRNA = gsub(">","",miRNA),
         score = as.numeric(gsub("Score: ","", score)),
         target = gsub(" gene=.*","",target)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(miRNA %in% repChecked)

ggplot(targetsPR, aes(x=score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5)) +
  ggtitle("psRobot score of miRNA-mRNA pairs") +
  theme_bw()
```

## TAPIR fasta
```{r}
targetsTPf <- list.files(here("data/analysis/results/targetPrediction_all/TAPIRfasta"),
                         pattern = ".txt", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE) %>%
  map(function(f){
    lines <- readLines(f)
    data.frame(miRNA = grep("^miRNA ", lines, value = TRUE),
               target = grep("^target ", lines, value = TRUE),
               score = grep("^score ", lines, value = TRUE),
               mfe_ratio = grep("^mfe_ratio ", lines, value = TRUE))}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(miRNA = gsub("miRNA *","",miRNA),
         target = gsub("target *","",target),
         score = as.numeric(gsub("score *","",score)),
         mfe_ratio = as.numeric(gsub("mfe_ratio *","",mfe_ratio))) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(miRNA %in% repChecked)

ggplot(targetsTPf, aes(x=score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3,3.5)) +
  ggtitle("TAPIR fasta score of miRNA-mRNA pairs") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(targetsTPf, aes(x=mfe_ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +
  ggtitle("TAPIR fasta minimum free energy ratio of miRNA-mRNA pairs") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(targetsTPf, aes(x=mfe_ratio, y=score)) +
  geom_density_2d_filled() +
  geom_smooth(colour = "red") +
  ggtitle("TAPIR fasta minimum free energy ratio vs score of miRNA-mRNA pairs") +
  theme_bw()
```

The pairs with lower score has higher free energy ratio as expected.

## TAPIR hybrid
```{r}
targetsTPh <- list.files(here("data/analysis/results/targetPrediction_all/TAPIRhybrid"),
                         pattern = ".txt", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE) %>%
  map(function(f){
    lines <- readLines(f)
    data.frame(miRNA = grep("^miRNA ", lines, value = TRUE),
               target = grep("^target ", lines, value = TRUE),
               score = grep("^score ", lines, value = TRUE),
               mfe_ratio = grep("^mfe_ratio ", lines, value = TRUE))}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(miRNA = gsub("miRNA *","",miRNA),
         target = gsub("target *","",target),
         score = as.numeric(gsub("score *","",score)),
         mfe_ratio = as.numeric(gsub("mfe_ratio *","",mfe_ratio))) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(miRNA %in% repChecked)

ggplot(targetsTPh, aes(x=score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3,3.5,4.0)) +
  ggtitle("TAPIR hybrid score of miRNA-mRNA pairs") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(targetsTPh, aes(x=mfe_ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +
  ggtitle("TAPIR hybrid minimum free energy ratio of miRNA-mRNA pairs") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(targetsTPh, aes(x=mfe_ratio, y=score)) +
  geom_density_2d_filled() +
  geom_smooth(colour = "red") +
  ggtitle("TAPIR hybrid minimum free energy ratio vs score of miRNA-mRNA pairs") +
  theme_bw()
```

The pairs with lower score has higher free energy ratio as expected.

## Combine

I will take all predicted pairs from default params of all programs
```{r}
targetsAll <- targetsPT %>% 
  dplyr::rename(psRNATarget_Expectation = Expectation,
                miRNA = miRNA_Acc.,
                target = Target_Acc.) %>% 
  dplyr::select(miRNA,target,psRNATarget_Expectation) %>% 
  full_join(targetsTF %>% 
              dplyr::rename(targetFinder_score = score,
                            miRNA = query) %>% 
              mutate(target = gsub(" gene", "", target)) %>% 
              dplyr::select(miRNA,target,targetFinder_score), 
            by = c("miRNA","target"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  full_join(targetsTPf %>% 
              dplyr::rename(TAPIRfasta_score = score) %>% 
              dplyr::select(miRNA,target,TAPIRfasta_score), 
            by = c("miRNA","target"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  full_join(targetsTPh %>% 
              dplyr::rename(TAPIRhybrid_score = score) %>% 
              dplyr::select(miRNA,target,TAPIRhybrid_score), 
            by = c("miRNA","target"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  full_join(targetsPR %>% 
              dplyr::rename(psRobot_score = score), 
            by = c("miRNA","target"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(NumberOfPrograms = 4 - (is.na(psRNATarget_Expectation) + is.na(targetFinder_score) + (is.na(TAPIRfasta_score) & is.na(TAPIRhybrid_score)) + is.na(psRobot_score)))

dat <- targetsAll %>% 
  mutate(pairID = paste0(miRNA,target))

pairList <- list(
  "psRNAtarget" = unique(dat$pairID[! is.na(dat$psRNATarget_Expectation)]),
  "TargetFinder" = unique(dat$pairID[! is.na(dat$targetFinder_score)]),
  "TAPIR" = unique(dat$pairID[! (is.na(dat$TAPIRfasta_score) & is.na(dat$TAPIRhybrid_score))]),
  "PSROBOT" = unique(dat$pairID[! is.na(dat$psRobot_score)]))

ggVennDiagram(pairList, label_alpha = 0, label = "count") + 
  scale_fill_gradient(low="white",high = "dodgerblue") + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .1))

pairList <- list(
  "psRNAtarget" = unique(dat$pairID[! is.na(dat$psRNATarget_Expectation)]),
  "TargetFinder" = unique(dat$pairID[! is.na(dat$targetFinder_score)]),
  "TAPIRfasta" = unique(dat$pairID[! is.na(dat$TAPIRfasta_score)]),
  "TAPIRhybrid" = unique(dat$pairID[! is.na(dat$TAPIRhybrid_score)]),
  "PSROBOT" = unique(dat$pairID[! is.na(dat$psRobot_score)]))

upset(fromList(pairList),nsets = 5, nintersects = NA)
ggVennDiagram(discard_at(pairList,"psRNAtarget"), label_alpha = 0, label = "count") + 
  scale_fill_gradient(low="white",high = "dodgerblue") + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .1))
```

psRNAtarget gives substantial amount of unique predictions.

# Combining with DE results

We check if the pairs show up as DE from both miRNA and mRNA comparisons on the different direction. Here we will also check if the pairs show up as DE in the same direction in any comparisons, and remove such pairs.

First, we load up the DEG lists.
```{r}
resSEm <- readRDS(here("data/analysis/mRNA/flipComp_mRNA_SE_ddsResults_omitSeedling.rds"))[["names"]]
resZEm <- readRDS(here("data/analysis/mRNA/flipComp_mRNA_ZE_ddsResults.rds"))[["names"]]
resSEmi <- readRDS(here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_finalSE_ddsResults.rds"))[["names"]]
resZEmi <- readRDS(here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_finalZE_ddsResults.rds"))[["names"]]
```

Then we check if the mi and target belong to any DE comparison
```{r, eval=FALSE}
dat <- targetPairs %>% 
  dplyr::filter(miRNA %in% c(unlist(resSEmi),unlist(resZEmi))) %>% 
  mutate(target = strsplit(target, split = ".", fixed = TRUE) %>% map_chr(~ .x[[1]])) %>% 
  mutate(
    miRNA_upDE = map(miRNA, function(mi){
      x <- names(resZEmi[["up"]])[map_lgl(resZEmi[["up"]], ~ mi %in% .x)]
      y <- names(resSEmi[["up"]])[map_lgl(resSEmi[["up"]], ~ mi %in% .x)]
      return(unique(c(x,y)))}),
    miRNA_dnDE = map(miRNA, function(mi){
      x <- names(resZEmi[["dn"]])[map_lgl(resZEmi[["dn"]], ~ mi %in% .x)]
      y <- names(resSEmi[["dn"]])[map_lgl(resSEmi[["dn"]], ~ mi %in% .x)]
      return(unique(c(x,y)))}),
    mRNA_upDE = map(target, function(m){
      x <- names(resZEm[["up"]])[map_lgl(resZEm[["up"]], ~ m %in% .x)]
      y <- names(resSEm[["up"]])[map_lgl(resSEm[["up"]], ~ m %in% .x)]
      return(unique(c(x,y)))}),
    mRNA_dnDE = map(target, function(m){
      x <- names(resZEm[["dn"]])[map_lgl(resZEm[["dn"]], ~ m %in% .x)]
      y <- names(resSEm[["dn"]])[map_lgl(resSEm[["dn"]], ~ m %in% .x)]
    return(unique(c(x,y)))}))

dat2 <- dat %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(miRNA_up_mRNA_dn = ifelse(length(miRNA_upDE) > 0 & length(mRNA_dnDE) > 0,
                                   intersect(miRNA_upDE, mRNA_dnDE),NA),
         miRNA_dn_mRNA_up = ifelse(length(miRNA_dnDE) > 0 & length(mRNA_upDE) > 0,
                                   intersect(miRNA_dnDE, mRNA_upDE),NA),
         miRNA_up_mRNA_up = ifelse(length(miRNA_upDE) > 0 & length(mRNA_upDE) > 0,
                                   intersect(miRNA_upDE, mRNA_upDE),NA),
         miRNA_dn_mRNA_dn = ifelse(length(miRNA_dnDE) > 0 & length(mRNA_dnDE) > 0,
                                   intersect(miRNA_dnDE, mRNA_dnDE),NA))
saveRDS(dat2, here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_TargetPairs_finalMetadata_DEdirections_tempB4filter.rds"))
```

```{r}
dat2 <- readRDS(here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_TargetPairs_finalMetadata_DEdirections_tempB4filter.rds"))

targetPairsDE <- dat2 %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(miRNA_up_mRNA_dn) | !is.na(miRNA_dn_mRNA_up)) %>% 
  #dplyr::filter(is.na(miRNA_up_mRNA_up) & is.na(miRNA_dn_mRNA_dn)) %>% 
  mutate(selComp =  paste(c(na.omit(miRNA_up_mRNA_dn), na.omit(miRNA_dn_mRNA_up)), collapse = ",")) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(targetPairsDE, here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_TargetPairs_finalMetadata_DEdirections.rds"))
```

Among `r nrow(dat2)` pairs that are predicted for DE miRNAs, `r sum(!is.na(dat2$miRNA_up_mRNA_dn) | !is.na(dat2$miRNA_dn_mRNA_up))` pairs are DE in opposite direction, and `r sum(!is.na(dat2$miRNA_up_mRNA_up) | !is.na(dat2$miRNA_dn_mRNA_dn))` pairs are DE in the same direction.

Here are pairs that show up in opposite direction in some comparison and show up in same direction on another
```{r}
dat2 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(miRNA_up_mRNA_dn) | !is.na(miRNA_dn_mRNA_up)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(miRNA_up_mRNA_up) | !is.na(miRNA_dn_mRNA_dn)) %>% 
  knitr::kable()
```

In the end, we did not remove pairs that are DE in the same direction because it might be results of mRNA being targeted by other regulators than miRNA. We take all `r sum(!is.na(dat2$miRNA_up_mRNA_dn) | !is.na(dat2$miRNA_dn_mRNA_up))` pairs that are DE in opposite direction. That consist of `r length(unique(targetPairsDE$miRNA))` miRNAs and `r length(unique(targetPairsDE$target))` genes.

# Calculate correlation

```{r}
minames <- unlist(c(resZEmi,resSEmi), use.names = FALSE) %>% 
  unique()
```

Of `r length(minames)` miRNAs that are DE in any comparisons, we will check their correlation against mRNA expression value of all the possible targets first, then check for the actual sequence match from target prediction table.

Read metadata tables that contains matching mRNA and miRNA samples
```{r}
miR_lowQual <- c("PabK14-03SM_SR1","PabK14-03RO_SR2","Pab738_2_FMG_MIR1")

samples <- bind_rows(
  read_csv(here("doc/metadataSE_mRNA_miRNA.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(! is.na(miR_NGI_ID)) %>% 
    mutate(Replicate = as.character(Replicate),
           Type = "SE",
           StageType = paste0(Type, "_", Stage),
           Stage = paste0("S",Stage),
           Dataset = "SE") %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Stage %in% paste0("S", 1:6)),
  read_csv(here("doc/metadataZE_mRNA_miRNA.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(! is.na(miR_NGI_ID)) %>% 
    mutate(StageType = paste0(Type, "_", Stage),
           Stage = paste0("Z",Stage),
           Dataset = "ZE")) %>% 
  mutate(StageType = factor(StageType,
                        levels = c(
                          paste0("SE_",1:6),
                          paste0("SD_",1:3),
                          paste0("ZE_",c(4:7,"8-9",10)),
                          paste0("FG_",c(4:7,"8-9",10)))),
         Stage = factor(Stage, levels = c(paste0("S",1:6),paste0("Z",c(1:7,"8-9",10))))) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(! miR_User_ID %in% miR_lowQual)

mtargets <- targetPairs %>% 
  pull(target) %>% 
  strsplit(split = ".", fixed = TRUE) %>% 
  map_chr(~ .x[[1]]) %>% 
  unique()
```

we load expression data (vst) of both miRNA and mRNA dataset
```{r, message=FALSE}
vstmiSE <- readRDS(here("data/analysis/results/miRNA_SE_nonmodelaware-vst.rds"))
vstmiZE <- readRDS(here("data/analysis/results/miRNA_ZE_nonmodelaware-vst.rds"))
```

## SE dataset

```{r}
minames <- unlist(resSEmi, use.names = FALSE) %>% unique()
```

For SE dataset, there are `r length(minames)` miRNAs that are DE in any comparisons.

Arrange both miRNA vst table and mRNA vst tablt to have similar colOrder accoding to the samples table
```{r}
samplesSE <- samples %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Dataset == "SE")

stopifnot(all(samplesSE$SampleID %in% colnames(vstmSE)))
rname <- intersect(rownames(vstmSE), mtargets)
vstm <- vstmSE[rname, samplesSE$SampleID]

stopifnot(all(samplesSE$miR_User_ID %in% colnames(vstmiSE)))
vstmi <- vstmiSE[minames, samplesSE$miR_User_ID]
```

Remove genes and miRNAs that have 0 reads in all SE samples
```{r}
vstmi <- vstmi %>% 
  .[rowSums(.) > 0, ] %>% 
  .[rowSds(.) > 0, ]

vstm <- vstm %>% 
  .[rowSums(.) > 0, ] %>% 
  .[rowSds(.) > 0, ]
```

Compute correlation of DE plant miRNAs against target mRNAs
```{r, eval=FALSE}
plan(strategy = "multisession")
samplewise_cor <- future_lapply(minames, function(mi) {
  e_miR <- vstmi[mi, ]

  if (sd(e_miR) == 0) return(NULL)

  map_dfr(rownames(vstm), function(m) {
    e_mR <- vstm[m, ]

    ct <- cor.test(e_miR, e_mR, method = "pearson")
    return(tibble(
      miRNA = mi,
      mRNA  = m,
      cor   = unname(ct$estimate),
      pval  = ct$p.value))
  })
}) %>% 
  bind_rows()
plan(strategy = "sequential")
saveRDS(samplewise_cor, here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_SE_onlyTargetPairs_finalMetadata_corrSampleWise_withPval.rds"))
```

Histogram of correlation coefficients
```{r}
samplewise_cor <- readRDS(here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_SE_onlyTargetPairs_finalMetadata_corrSampleWise_withPval.rds"))
hist(samplewise_cor$cor)
```

correlation coefficient vs -log10(pvalue)
```{r}
ggplot(samplewise_cor, aes(x=cor, y=-log10(pval))) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()
```

Maximum correlation coefficient with pval < 0.05
```{r}
samplewise_cor %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cor < 0 & pval < 0.05) %>% 
  pull(cor) %>% 
  max()
```

## Redo Benjamini and Hochberg-adjusted p < 0.05

The number of target pairs affect the cutoff of each dataset. I will combine all of the dataset specific correlation tables together and redo FDR correction. The one that use both dataset in one run I will discard. Ref: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2686738/

```{r}
samplewise_cor <- list(
  SE = readRDS(here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_SE_onlyTargetPairs_finalMetadata_corrSampleWise_withPval.rds")),
  SDZE = readRDS(here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_ZE_SDZE_onlyTargetPairs_finalMetadata_corrSampleWise_withPval.rds")),
  SDFG = readRDS(here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_ZE_SDFG_onlyTargetPairs_finalMetadata_corrSampleWise_withPval.rds"))) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "Dataset") %>% 
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"))
```

Maximum correlation coefficient with padj < 0.05
```{r}
samplewise_cor %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cor < 0 & padj < 0.05) %>% 
  pull(cor) %>% 
  max()
```

# Target prediction combined with DE and correlation (negative correlation coefficient with padj < 0.05)

We combine prediction results from prediction programs with the pearson correlations and the one shows up in DE
```{r}
targetPairs_pcor <- samplewise_cor %>% 
  split(., .$Dataset) %>% 
  map(dplyr::filter, cor < 0 & padj < 0.05) %>% 
  map(dplyr::select,-Dataset) %>% 
  imap(~ dplyr::rename(
    .x,
    target = mRNA,
    !!paste0("cor", .y) := cor,
    !!paste0("pval", .y) := pval,
    !!paste0("padj", .y) := padj))

targetPairsFinal <- targetPairs %>%
  mutate(target = strsplit(target, split = ".", fixed = TRUE) %>% map_chr(~ .x[[1]])) %>% 
  left_join(readRDS(here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_TargetPairs_finalMetadata_DEdirections.rds")) %>% 
              dplyr::select(miRNA,target,selComp), by = c("miRNA","target")) %>% 
  left_join(targetPairs_pcor[["SE"]], by = c("miRNA","target")) %>% 
  left_join(targetPairs_pcor[["SDZE"]], by = c("miRNA","target")) %>% 
  left_join(targetPairs_pcor[["SDFG"]], by = c("miRNA","target")) %>% 
  mutate(isSE = (!is.na(corSE) | grepl("SE",selComp)),
         isZE = (!is.na(corSDZE) | !is.na(corSDFG) | grepl("SD",selComp) | grepl("ZE",selComp) | grepl("FG",selComp)))

saveRDS(targetPairsFinal, here("data/analysis/results/flipComp_1stTier_TargetPairsFinal_withPval.rds"))
```

From `r nrow(targetPairsFinal)` predicted pairs, here are numbers of pair show up from DE and correlation
```{r}
ggVennDiagram(list(DE = which(! is.na(targetPairsFinal$selComp)),
                   pcorSE = which(! is.na(targetPairsFinal$corSE)),
                   pcorSDZE = which(! is.na(targetPairsFinal$corSDZE)),
                   pcorSDFG = which(! is.na(targetPairsFinal$corSDFG))),
              label_alpha = 0, label = "count") + 
  scale_fill_gradient(low="white",high = "dodgerblue") + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .1))
```

DE method yield more pairs. Interestingly there are some that show up as target pairs from all methods and correlations we try, they are
```{r}

  dplyr::filter(! is.na(selComp)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(! is.na(corSE)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(! is.na(corSDZE)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(! is.na(corSDFG)) %>% 
  left_join(annotRow %>% dplyr::rename(miRNA = id), by = "miRNA") %>% 
  knitr::kable()
```

# Expression plots of target pairs

We will plot `r sum(!(is.na(targetPairsFinal$corSE) & is.na(targetPairsFinal$corSDZE) & is.na(targetPairsFinal$corSDFG)))` pairs that are predicted by at least 3 programs and detected as pair by correlation method. For pairs that are detected by DE method, we still keep them but they are not suitable for this type of plot.
```{r}
stopifnot(all(rownames(vstmiSE) == rownames(vstmiZE)))
vstmi <- cbind(vstmiSE,vstmiZE)

rname <- intersect(rownames(vstmSE), rownames(vstmZE))
vstm <- cbind(vstmSE[rname,],vstmZE[rname,])

samples$Type <- factor(samples$Type, levels = c("SE","SD","ZE","FG"))
```

### Targeted in SE

`r sum(! is.na(targetPairsFinal$corSE))` pairs

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
targetPairsFinal %>% 
  dplyr::filter(! is.na(targetPairsFinal$corSE)) %>% 
  split(., .$miRNA) %>% 
  map(pull, target) %>% 
  iwalk(function(g,mi){
    
    if (length(g) == 1) {
      dat1 <- vstm[intersect(rownames(vstm),g),] %>%
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        setNames(g) %>% 
        scale() %>%
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
        inner_join(samples, by = "SampleID") %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = setdiff(colnames(.), colnames(samples)),
                     names_to = "id", values_to = "scaled_expression")# %>%
        #mutate(id = "targets")
    } else {
      dat1 <- vstm[intersect(rownames(vstm),g),] %>%
        t() %>%
        scale() %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
        inner_join(samples, by = "SampleID") %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = setdiff(colnames(.), colnames(samples)),
                     names_to = "id", values_to = "scaled_expression")# %>%
        #mutate(id = "targets")
    }
    
    if (length(g) > 12) {anncol = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12,"Set3"))(length(g))
    } else {anncol = brewer.pal(length(g),"Set3")}
    
    dat2 <- vstmi[intersect(rownames(vstmi),mi),] %>%
      scale() %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      setNames(mi) %>%
        rownames_to_column("miR_User_ID") %>%
        inner_join(samples, by = "miR_User_ID") %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = setdiff(colnames(.), colnames(samples)),
                   names_to = "id", values_to = "scaled_expression")# %>%
      #mutate(id = "miRNA")
    
    if(mi %in% mature_known){
      knownID <- paste(mature_refs$Description[mature_refs$id == mi])
    } else { knownID <- ""}
    
    p <- ggplot(bind_rows(dat1,dat2),aes(x = StageType, y = scaled_expression, col = id, group = id)) +  
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
      facet_grid(col = vars(Type), scale = "free") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(setNames("black",mi),
                                    setNames(anncol,g))) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
      ggtitle(paste(mi, knownID))
    plot(p)
})
```

# GO enrichment of the target genes

Preparation: test set
```{r}
resList = list(
  "Targets_All" = targetPairsFinal %>% dplyr::filter(!(is.na(selComp) & is.na(corSE) & is.na(corSDZE) & is.na(corSDFG)),) %>% pull(target) %>% unique(),
  "Targets_SE" = targetPairsFinal %>% dplyr::filter(isSE) %>% pull(target) %>% unique(),
  "Targets_ZE" = targetPairsFinal %>% dplyr::filter(isZE) %>% pull(target) %>% unique(),
  "Targets_Both" = targetPairsFinal %>% dplyr::filter(isSE & isZE) %>% pull(target) %>% unique(),
  "Targets_SEonly" = targetPairsFinal %>% dplyr::filter(isSE & !isZE) %>% pull(target) %>% unique(),
  "Targets_ZEonly" = targetPairsFinal %>% dplyr::filter(isZE & !isSE) %>% pull(target) %>% unique())
```

Preparation: background set = genes that has expression in at least 2 samples
```{r}
rname <- intersect(rownames(vstmSE), rownames(vstmZE))
vstm <- cbind(vstmSE[rname,],vstmZE[rname,]) %>% 
  .[rowSums(.) > 0, ] %>% 
  .[rowSds(.) > 0, ]
background <- rownames(vstm)[rowSums(vstm > 0) > 1]
```

Number of genes in background set: `r length(background)`

Preparation: GO terms
```{r}
# annot <- read_tsv("reference/Picea-abies/v2.0/annotation/Picab02_230926_at01_longest_representative_annotations_merged_sorted.tsv.gz", col_names = T, show_col_types = F) %>%
annot <- read_tsv("reference/Picea-abies/v2.0/annotation/Picab02_230926_at01_longest_representative_annotations_merged_sorted.tsv.gz", 
                  col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(id, delim = ".",names = c("GeneID", "mRNA", "mRNAID")) %>%
  mutate(GOs = paste0(gsub(",","|",eggnog_go),"|",gsub(",","|",interpro_go))) %>%
  dplyr::select(GeneID, GOs)

goannot <- lapply(unlist(annot[,2],use.names=FALSE),strsplit,"\\|") %>%
  lapply(unlist) %>%
  lapply(unique) %>%
  lapply(function(x) x[! x == "NA"])
names(goannot) <- unlist(annot[,1],use.names=FALSE)

remove(annot)

# remove terms that are not present in arabidopsis
atannot <- read_tsv("reference/Arabidopsis-thaliana/ARAPORT11/annotation/ATH_GO_GOSLIM_091024.txt.gz", 
                    col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE, comment = "!") %>% 
  pull(X6) %>% 
  unique()

goannot <- goannot %>% 
  map(intersect, atannot) %>% 
  discard(~ length(.x) == 0)
```

Enrichment
```{r, message=FALSE}
enrList <- map(resList, ~ topGO(.x, background, goannot, alpha=0.05, p.adjust="BH", getgenes=TRUE))
saveRDS(enrList, here("data/analysis/mRNA/flipComp_1stTier_GOenrBH_targets_withPval.rds"))

enrList <- map(enrList, ~ discard(.x, ~ length(.x) == 0))
enrList <- discard(enrList, ~ length(.x) == 0)
```

## Dotplot
```{r}
iwalk(enrList, function(e,p){
  dat <- e %>%
    map(dplyr::select, -allgenes, -siggenes) %>% 
    bind_rows(.id = "GOcategory") %>% 
    mutate(FDR = parse_double(sub("<","",FDR)),
           GeneRatio = Significant/Annotated,
           Count = as.numeric(Significant)) %>%
    mutate(Term = factor(Term, levels = Term[order(GeneRatio)]))
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x =Term, y = GeneRatio, color = FDR, size = Count)) + 
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
    theme_bw() + 
    ylab("GeneRatio") + 
    xlab("") + 
    facet_grid(GOcategory ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free") +
    ggtitle(paste0(p," GO enrichment")) +
    coord_flip()
  plot(p)
})
```
